newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah finds support at 2,650 vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah finds support at 2,650 vs dlr.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah appeared to find some support at 2,650 against the dollar as speculators continued their attack on the currency.
One Japanese bank dealer said the dollar was taken once at the 2,650 level but some offers seemed to at least temporarily halt the U.S. currency from breaking the fragile resistance.
"The target is clear. Speculators want to test the band at 2,681 level," the dealer said.
The intervention band was set at 2,377/2,681 on Friday.
The rupiah opened at 2,510/20 on Monday and plunged in the wake of a fierce overseas speculative attack.
